paragraphs.text: Berserker is a creature type for combatants who enter a frenzy in battle, gaining great speed and battle prowess.
Common abilities for berserkers are haste , rampage , and bloodthirst . Most berserkers are red . Examples include: Vulshok Berserker , Ghor-Clan Savage , Kill-Suit Cultist and Raging Goblin .
Berserker debuted as a creature type with Aerathi Berserker from Legends . It became a supported creature type when Goblin Striker was printed in Mirrodin .
